paragraphs.text: Lucrezia was a city-state of the same name in south-western Jamuraa on Dominaria , that was ruled by a princess of the same name .

The city was constantly at war with the shah of Fysmatan , another port city on the shore of the Sea of Serenity . Lucrezian marines, an elite unit of her navy, were one of the most disciplined forces to sail the sea.
